Drain unblocking: a homeowner's guide

Blocked drains are one of the most common household plumbing problems, and most start with grease, hair or wipes.

When to call a professional for drain unblocking

If plunging and hot water do not clear the blockage, professional drain unblocking with a jetter clears even the toughest blockages in Springfield homes.

A camera survey shows whether the drain pipe is cracked or blocked by tree roots before any digging starts.

Preventing blocked drains

Use a sink strainer, never pour fat down the drain and flush only toilet paper.
